changelog: 9.7 - Stream recovery aur error-cache fix. Catalogue kuch titles ke liye decoy clip bhejta hai; app ab signCookie ki signed CloudFront policy se asli manifest banati hai, phir resource-position/v2 se link recover karti hai, aur resource/v2 se extra mirrors jodti hai. Saath hi ek bug fix: server error responses (jaise 406) ab cache nahi hote, isliye upstream theek hone par app turant naya data laata hai, purana error repeat nahi karta.
